claims: An RCD typically cuts power within 10 to 40 milliseconds when current leakage is detected.
This rapid response time helps prevent severe electric shocks and potential fatalities.

claims.text: RCDs should operate within 25-40 milliseconds with leakage currents greater than 30 mA.
